title: Projection Area of 3D Shapes
summary: Given an n x n grid with 1 x 1 x 1 cubes placed on cells (i, j) where the value v = grid[i][j] indicates the height of the tower, calculate the total area of the projections onto the xy, yz, and zx planes.
statement: Given an n x n grid with 1 x 1 x 1 cubes placed on cells (i, j) where the value v = grid[i][j] indicates the height of the tower, calculate the total area of the projections onto the xy, yz, and zx planes.
constraints: Each cell height is a vertical stack of unit cubes.
Sum top, front, and side projection areas.
reference_solution:
def projection_area(grid):
 return sum(value>0 for row in grid for value in row)+sum(max(row) for row in grid)+sum(max(row[c] for row in grid) for c in range(len(grid[0])))
hints: Top projection counts occupied cells; the two side projections take maxima along rows and columns.
Each viewing direction hides all cubes except the footprint or tallest stack on each sight line.
editorial: Each viewing direction hides all cubes except the footprint or tallest stack on each sight line.
